content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin International Degree-Seeking Students Getting started! Getting started! The Student Life Cycle - our onboaring tool for international degree seeking students! New at the HTW and in Berlin? Then our moodle course “Student Life Cycle” is just right for you! Here you will find all the important information about studying at HTW and your stay in Berlin! Starting your studies Study organization and support during your studies Contact persons Formalities, living and working in Germany Insider tips about Berlin Funding opportunities for international students and much more Follow this link to take advantage of our offer! HTW students please log in with your HTW account Guests please use the guest log in
